question: Count current F customers from TX whose first sale year is 2001.
expected_sql:
SELECT cp.gender, a.state, cd.year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_record) AS customers
        FROM clients c
        JOIN client_profiles cp ON c.current_client_profile_ref = cp.client_profile_record
        JOIN addresses a ON c.current_address_ref = a.address_record
        JOIN calendar_days cd ON c.first_sale_calendar_day_ref = cd.calendar_day_record
        WHERE cp.gender = 'F' AND a.state = 'TX' AND cd.year = 2001
        GROUP BY cp.gender, a.state, cd.year
actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_record) AS client_count
FROM clients c
INNER JOIN client_profiles cp
  ON c.current_client_profile_ref = cp.client_profile_record
INNER JOIN addresses a
  ON c.current_address_ref = a.address_record
INNER JOIN calendar_days cd
  ON c.first_sale_calendar_day_ref = cd.calendar_day_record
WHERE cp.gender = 'F'
  AND a.state = 'TX'
  AND cd.year = 2001
